letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai reminds me of the golden glow you bring into my life, and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad whispers your name. Today, as the calendar flips to a new day, I find myself counting the countless moments we’ve shared since that beautiful 23rd of February. You are my endless adventure, my calm in the desert, my laughter in the rain. I love you more than words can capture, my sweet cutie—forever and always.
poem:
In desert dunes and rainy streets we roam,  
Your smile lights the sky, my heart’s true home.  
Together we dance through sun and storm,  
Forever yours, in love’s warm form.
